source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TWM41WH8A / NS-TWM35W1 top-load washer (capacitive level)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before accessing internal components.

steps.title: Belt tension (F5)
steps.body: F5 on TWM35: load sensing failed — adjust belt tension per service manual. Verify drive belt not slipped.
steps.sourceExcerpt: F5 on TWM35: load sensing failed — adjust belt tension per service manual. Verify drive belt not slipped.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Test mode entered. Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After test mode entry, proceed with OEM troubleshooting steps.

steps.title: Test mode 5 — auto-sensing
steps.body: Enter test mode (Soak + Extra Rinse + Power). Within 9 s press Delay for auto-sensing test. Digital shows result within 3 s?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter test mode (Soak + Extra Rinse + Power). Within 9 s press Delay for auto-sensing test. Digital shows result within 3 s?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: No display after 3 s — replace Power PCB.

steps.title: Replace PCB or belt
steps.oemOutcome: Adjust belt tension; replace Power PCB if auto-sense test fails.

steps.title: Load sensing OK
steps.oemOutcome: Auto-sensing test displays result — F5 should not recur.
